title: Impact of CMB low-ℓ EE polarization data on dark energy parameterizations (Barua, Desai)
efc_relevance: Shows that excluding low-ℓ EE polarization (i.e. relaxing the tau_reio prior) pushes w_a more negative in CPL/JBP/BA parameterisations on Planck + ACT DR6 + DESI DR2 + Pantheon+, driven by the strengthening w_a–A_s and w_a–tau_reio correlations. Directly bears on EFC's effective w(z) representation of the L2→L3 transition — any EFC fit that quotes (w_0, w_a) must specify the low-ℓ EE handling, otherwise the EFC-vs-CPL discriminator inherits a prior-driven offset.
ledger_action: Add to WP3 Falsification Protocol as mandatory low-ℓ-EE handling note for EFC (w_0, w_a) reports; cross-reference framework:wCDM-CPL-Chevallier2001, arXiv:2503.14738 (DESI DR2) and arXiv:2605.27221 (DES Y6 multi-probe); required Predictions-Ledger note that EFC's L2→L3 (w_0, w_a) point estimate is conditional on the tau_reio prior choice.
